sourceFacts: Equilateral prism, incident ray enters face AB, reflects internally at face AC slightly above critical incidence, emerges via face BC
Emergent ray makes 30 degrees with outward normal to BC
Problem requests incidence angle and prism refractive index
missing: No explicit outside absolute refractive index
No quantitative tolerance for 'slightly above' the critical angle
No finite prism side length, launch position, illumination intensity or detector
source.interpretation: conditional 2D meridional equilateral triangle, not a published solved-question grade

geometry.faceNaming: A=(0,+70), B=(0,-70), C=(70sqrt3,0) in y-up mm; AB=face-12, BC=face-23, CA=face-31, launch from left

independentReference.assumption: Positive upper AC reflection and subsequent lower BC exit, ray enters AB and refracts then returns by a single TIR; not a route imposed on PhyDemo
independentReference.upperFaceTIRCondition: m*sin(alpha)>1; near equality is numerically withheld
independentReference.nInequality: m > sqrt(7/3) for the declared TIR branch and exit=30deg; equality is critical not above

rules: Build actual canonical v8 SingleRay and real native Glass from explicitly supplied source/material/geometry; never change public authoring scope
Record real pinned Glass callback order, native output and actual indices, error, truncation and stop status; no prescribed route to simulator

Qualify a test-only 3-face witness only when native completed, no errors/truncation/undefined, exactly three original events with TIR at face-31, 30 degree emergence at face-23 and >1e-5 dimensionless TIR margin
Below/critical threshold cannot be mislabelled a valid three-face TIR witness; near critical always withheld
Zero original JEE solved rate, no exterior default air, no invented emitted ray or physical image, no source-specified finite scale
Preserve frozen source and previous first attempts; prospective pure analytical inverse only if native feasibility and independent physics derivation pass
releaseHold: Research-only draft until actual native results inspected. A future public source/additional analytical model requires final exact-head CI and one focused Chat B review. No automatic merge of this experiment.
